raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from ingest_ts (CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE)), which is the next day's 02:00 batch load time for every row, so txn_date never matches the transaction date. This was introduced by the 2026-01-16 DE-398 refactor, and the 4582 flagged rows equal the POSTED row count, so every posted row is affected. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the intended meaning, which the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor checks, and the gold tables recompute from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
